summary: Run Set.forEach with a statically known callback through existing JsFunction call semantics.

target.notes: Callback is invoked as callback(value,value,set), preserving thisArg through canonical function-call lowering.

semantics.mutation_during_iteration: deleted-before-visit skipped; additions before completion visited; delete+readd may revisit

tests.name: addition visited
tests.input: const s=new Set([1]); const seen=[]; s.forEach(v=>{seen.push(v);if(v===1)s.add(2)}); console.log(seen);
